scope: taxonomy-only; existing canonical Poaceae learner species; no species-card, photo, genus/family, installation, county nativity, Pages, or schedule changes
related_noncanonical_taxon: Digitaria pubiflora (Vasey) Wipff; accepted by POWO; no installation or duplicate implied

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts this as Poaceae species rank, published 1940; existing learner binomial is correct. WFO corroborates. Do not rename.
POWO/WCVP accepts a separate species published 2001, distinct from D. cognata. This is a taxonomic boundary review, NOT an instruction to install a new card.
POWO lists 1906 Leptoloma combination as homotypic synonym of D. cognata; the alternative genus reflects a taxonomic treatment, not a second learner species.
POWO lists 1824 basionym as homotypic synonym.
POWO lists this name under D. cognata as a homotypic synonym but explicitly marks it an illegitimate later homonym; retain authorship and nomenclatural qualification.
POWO lists the 1833 name under D. cognata as homotypic, illegitimate and superfluous; preserve status.
POWO lists this 1824 name as a heterotypic synonym of D. cognata; do not confuse with two author- and date-sensitive var. pubiflorum names.
POWO places the earlier 1889 variety under accepted D. pubiflora; 2018 Wipff & Shaw directly cite this original name and its El Paso lectotype.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Panicum autumnale var. pubiflorum Vasey ex L.H.Dewey (1894)
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO places the 1894 later homonym under D. cognata and marks it illegitimate. Preserve distinct author, date and status; do not equate with Vasey's 1889 name.
POWO treats the 2018 Leptoloma combination as homotypic synonym of accepted D. pubiflora; primary publication confirms the combination.
POWO/WCVP currently synonymizes the 2018 Texas species with D. pubiflora. The 2018 authors treated it as distinct; preserve that disagreement in separate UNRESOLVED decision.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Leptoloma pubiflorum var. syrticola (Wipff & R.B.Shaw) Allred
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO lists the 2019 variety as heterotypic synonym of accepted D. pubiflora, not D. cognata.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Assertion: all historical names containing pubiflorum or pubiflora are synonyms of Digitaria cognata
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Author-, rank- and concept-sensitive mapping required
scientific_decisions.reason: Blanket mapping is false. POWO distinguishes accepted D. pubiflora, Vasey's 1889 variety and the 1894 illegitimate later homonym, with different accepted targets. FAIL is for the proposed assertion, not the learner name.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Digitaria cognata subsp. pubiflora (Vasey ex L.H.Dewey) Wipff
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Conflict: POWO record maps to D. cognata; 2018 taxonomic treatment associates the pubiflora concept with separately accepted D. pubiflora
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO's name record explicitly synonymizes this 1988 subspecies under D. cognata, yet its accepted D. pubiflora and Wipff & Shaw 2018 cite the earlier subspecies combination in the pubiflora lineage. Preserve the recorded POWO mapping and authority-level concept conflict; do not silently rewrite either.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Leptoloma syrticola as species vs Digitaria pubiflora as accepted species
scientific_decisions.reason: Wipff & Shaw 2018 describe L. syrticola as a distinct rhizomatous Texas sandland species versus densely cespitose nonrhizomatous L. pubiflorum; current POWO/WCVP synonymizes it under D. pubiflora. Do not reassign historical specimens without examining morphology and voucher.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical label 'Panicum autumnale var. pubiflorum' without author and date
scientific_decisions.reason: Cannot distinguish Vasey 1889 (current D. pubiflora) from Vasey ex L.H.Dewey 1894 (current D. cognata) using abbreviated name alone. Require full author, date and original voucher.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual Digitaria cognata learner photo identifications
scientific_decisions.reason: Existing canonical learner remains FIELD_READY_PHOTO_GAPS, with unresolved source-vouchered crown, ligule, measured spikelets and branch-junction macros. Accepted name verification is not proof that every photographed plant represents narrow D. cognata rather than related historical concepts.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual hybrid or introgression status of Digitaria cognata specimens
scientific_decisions.reason: Neither POWO acceptance nor 2018 taxonomic revision establishes hybrid ancestry for any photographed learner plant. Do not infer hybrid parentage, collapse concepts or override any existing identification hold.

scientific_guardrails: Preserve existing learner and its exact photo/identity scientific HOLDs.
Preserve author-sensitive 1889 vs 1894 historical variety mapping and illegitimate-homonym label.
Preserve POWO's explicit 1988 subspecies mapping while recording the conflicting species-level concept in the 2018 primary revision.
Do not infer hybrid parentage or county nativity.
No changes to canonical species, galleries, genus/family lessons, installation, Sheets, or Pages.
